segments: The 18th dynasty: the Arab kings. Abu'l-Abbas Abdallah
and he lived twenty-two years.
And in the year in which Abu Ja'far began to reign, which was the year
1066 of the Greeks,
and of the Arabs
Constantine, king of the Romans, went out against Qaliqala (Qaliqala?, which is Erzerum),
and he captured it and left it desolate,
and he placed a garrison in the fortress of Kamakh.
Now Abdallah, son of Ali, when he heard of the death of Abu'l-Abbas,
began to travel through the cities and make himself king.
Abu Ja'far sent against him Abu Muslim, the commander of the army, and put him to flight.
Then that same Abu Muslim, the commander of the army, rebelled against Abu Ja'far,
and went around the cities to seize the kingdom.
Then Abu Ja'far sent to him a man named Isa,
who persuaded him and brought him.
And as soon as he entered,
Abu Ja'far made a sign, and he was killed.
And the kingdom of the Arabs was firmly established for him.
And he commanded, and Melitene was rebuilt as formerly,
and he stationed an army in it.
And he also rebuilt Qaliqala,
and placed a garrison in it.
And in the year 1071,
this [land] was subjugated to the Arabs:
that which from the north the Caspian Sea borders,
and from the east Gorgan,
and from the south Media and a portion of Parthia,
and from the west Daylam (Dylum,
Deylam,
Rudbar?). And in it are five walled cities;
and it is dense with mountains, forests, meadows, and valleys,
and its entrances are difficult.
Its length from east to west is forty parasangs,
and its width from north to south is twenty parasangs.
And in the year 1073
1073 of the Greeks (762 of our Lord?), Abu Ja'far built a city on the Tigris above Ctesiphon,
and called it Baghdad, after the name of an idol that was in that place;
and he resided in it.
And a year later, a certain Muhammad, from the descendants of Ali the son-in-law of their prophet and his cousin, rebelled against him;
and all Arabdom was drawn after him.
And Isa, the commander of the army, went against him,
and killed him in Yathrib during the month of Ramadan and their fast.
And Ibrahim, the brother of this man, also rebelled in Basra,
and he too was killed.
And in that year the Khazars went out,
and took fifty thousand souls captive.
notes: [In] 1071 the Arabs conquered Africa. For also the region of Tabaristan at this time
